desc.ssoClient: OAuth2 or OIDC parameters for unified SSO

form.dingtalkCallbackUriHelp: Must be a valid http(s) URL, the redirect URL configured in DingTalk backend.
form.oauth2ScopeHelp: Requested OIDC/OAuth2 scope. Multiple values usually separated by space. Optional.
form.oauth2AccessTokenPropHelp: JSONPath for access_token in response (supports x.x.x). Default is access_token.
form.oauth2UserIdPropHelp: Extract user identifier from third-party response (e.g. id, sub).
form.oauth2UsernamePropHelp: Extract name, comma-separated for fallbacks (e.g. name,nickname).
form.wechatRedirectUriHelp: Redirect URI allowed for WeChat QR login.
form.ssoRoleListHelp: Roles automatically granted on first SSO login.
form.ssoOrgListHelp: If omitted, user will not belong to any organization on first login.
form.apiClientBaseUrlHelp: Base URL of the third-party API, e.g. https://api.dingtalk.com
form.apiServerClientIdHelp: Equals Application ID, used as API credential.
form.apiServerSecureKey: Secure Key (client_secret), leave empty to auto-generate
form.apiServerSecureKeyHelp: Used for signature or token exchange.
form.signatureMethodHelp: Used when accessing APIs via signatures.
form.ipWhiteListHelp: Comma separated IPs. Empty means no restriction.
form.apiServerRedirectUriPlaceholder: Please enter a valid redirect URI
form.apiServerRoleListHelp: API callers creating identities will inherit these roles.
form.pageBaseUrlHelp: The root entry URL of the UI page, e.g. https://my-app.com/
form.pageMenuApiHelp: Communication path to fetch dynamic submenus.
form.pageRouteTypeHelp: Used to build the remote page URL. Hash mode will generate /#/path automatically.
form.pageOwnerHelp: Used to set the owner of page menus; defaults to Application ID if empty.
